name: Sender
summary: Email and SMS marketing platform for small businesses and shops: newsletters, automation, landing pages, signup forms and popups and transactional email, with a generous free plan and paid tiers priced by list size.
best_for: small businesses, shops and creators with lists up to a few thousand subscribers who want newsletters, automation, forms and SMS at a low price, starting on a free plan that is generous on volume
skip_if: you need a long list of native integrations with niche tools, or deep CRM and sales pipeline features alongside your email, or you will not check the slider price for your real list size
honest_knock: The cheapest paid price only covers 500 subscribers, fewer than the 2,500 on the free plan, so the 8.01€ headline rises as soon as your list is larger; the page shows the step prices only on its slider. The 30% annual discount is for the first year and first-time users only. Prices exclude VAT. We could not read the refund terms: the terms-of-service link returned an error page on 13 October 2026. The support speed and customer figures on the pricing page are Sender's own claims. We have not used Sender ourselves.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-20; first read 2026-10-13 in a live browser on sender.net/pricing from a Netherlands connection, which shows euros, in both the annual and the monthly view with the FAQ opened; the US copy of the same page read the same night lists Standard at $108 a year, $75.60 the first year, and Professional at $180 a year, $126 the first year) Sender prices by the size of your list on a slider, and every figure here is for the lowest step. The Free Forever plan costs nothing, needs no card, never expires and covers up to 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 emails a month for one seat, with newsletters, automation, landing pages, signup forms and popups and transactional emails; your emails and forms carry Sender branding. Standard is 8.01€ a month on monthly billing for up to 500 subscribers and 6,000 emails a month, with 3 seats, no branding, SMS, unlimited templates and landing pages, A/B testing and ecommerce reports. Professional is 13.36€ a month for the same 500 subscribers and 12,000 emails, with 10 seats, a monthly SMS credit, advanced automation and reports, priority support and, on plans of 20,000 subscribers and up, a dedicated IP on request at no extra cost. Annual billing is the monthly price times twelve (96.18€ for Standard, 160.30€ for Professional), with 30% off the first year for first-time users: 67.32€ and 112.21€. Monthly email allowance on paid plans is 12 times your subscriber count on Standard and 24 times on Professional, with no daily sending limits. Enterprise is custom. A pay-as-you-go option sells credits without a subscription: 26€ for 5,000 emails. SMS is bought per message by destination country (0.107€ to the Netherlands on our reading of 20 October 2026). Prices exclude VAT. Every new account gets a 14-day Professional trial with no card, after which it falls back to Free.

schema_offer.description: Standard, per month billed monthly at the lowest subscriber step (up to 500 subscribers, 6,000 emails a month), excluding VAT; annual billing is 96.18€ a year with 30% off the first year for first-time users (67.32€); Professional 13.36€ a month or 160.30€ a year (112.21€ the first year); the price rises with the subscriber slider; shown in euros from a Netherlands connection; Sender's own llms.txt, read the same day, still quotes older starting prices: Standard from $7 a month on annual billing (about $10 monthly) and Professional from $14 (about $20 monthly); this record follows the pricing page. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-20.

compare_with.name: Moosend
compare_with.why: Moosend is in our dossiers too, re-verified on 9 October 2026: Pro from $7 a month billed yearly or $9 monthly for 500 contacts, rising with list size, with a 30-day free trial and no permanent free plan. Sender, re-read on 20 October 2026 in euros, has a Free Forever plan up to 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 emails a month, and Standard from 8.01€ a month at 500 subscribers, excluding VAT. The entry prices are close; the difference is that Sender lets a small list stay free indefinitely, while Moosend offers a trial and then charges. The currencies are not converted here.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Sender in an existing account: a test list with one test contact, a draft newsletter made from a ready-made template, the paid plan page on the Monthly tab in US dollars and the place of the Delete account button. Nothing was sent, the payment screen was not reached and nothing was paid. Start and account: the test started at 16:01 (Dutch time) in our existing account, already logged in, with the admin language English. The page complete-registration showed no form any more but the dashboard Let's get started with the checklist steps Complete registration, Verify email address and Add your sending domain already ticked. No registration field was filled in. No address, phone number or card was asked. The general settings hold a filled in company address, which was left unchanged and is not shown. Core action: at 16:02 the group Test List was made (Groups, Create new group, Group created). At 16:02:37 one test contact with a placeholder address on example.com was added by Add subscribers, Copy and paste, mapping the field Email and Organize and import with the group Test List preselected and Trigger active automations upon import off; the message Subscriber import complete / Your contact list is now ready followed and the list showed the contact in Test List (the group first counted 0 while it was Recalculating). At 16:03 the campaign Test newsletter was made (Email campaigns, Create email campaign, the subject, Save and continue, Design your email with the choices Drag and drop builder, Plain text email and Custom HTML email, a search for newsletter and the template Black Friday newsletter (light), Start creating). The builder showed Saved and Autosave, and the list showed Test newsletter as DRAFT, Edited 2026-11-17 16:04:06. The list and contact took about 1 minute and the draft about 3 minutes, in 12 steps in all. Nothing was sent, not even a test email, and Continue to the recipients was not used; the sender field held the account address by default and was not changed. Auto resend said Upgrade your plan to use this feature. Plans: the page settings/billing/upgrade showed Lock in your Black Friday price (Save 60% on 24 months, two years for less than ten months of value, or 30% on 12), an audience of 500 and the tabs Monthly, Annual (Save 30%) and 24-month (Up to 60%), in US dollars (the euro choice could not be opened). On Monthly at 500 subscribers Standard is $9 /mo ($7.65 /mo with Pay 3 months upfront, 15% OFF) with 6 000 emails a month, 500 subscribers, 180 AI credits, 3 role-based seats, No Sender branding, SMS messaging and unlimited templates and landing pages. Professional is $15 /mo ($12.75 with 3 months upfront) with 12 000 emails, 600 AI credits, 10 seats, free SMS, advanced automation and a priority tier. Enterprise has Custom price and Get a Demo, and a Pay as you go plan is also mentioned. The dossier gives 8.01 euro for Standard and 13.36 euro for Professional per month excluding VAT, so the currency and the amounts differ (the app showed dollars and a Black Friday setup). Checkout: the click on Upgrade to Standard, which leads to the payment screen, was blocked by the permission check of our tool, so the payment screen was not seen and nothing was entered. Cancelling: Account settings, General settings has a red button Delete account at the bottom; it was not clicked. No route to cancel a paid plan was seen because the account is on the free plan. Not tested: sending, a test email, connecting or authenticating a domain, the payment screen, the euro display, the annual and 24-month totals, the branding in a sent email, the limit of 2,500 subscribers, forms and automations. Clean up: the group Test List, the placeholder subscriber and the draft Test newsletter stay in the account; the tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The registration page showed no form for an account that already existed, the group counted 0 for a moment while it recalculated, the plan page only showed US dollars while the dossier prices are in euro, the plan page was a Black Friday offer with 24 month deals, and the step to the payment screen could not be taken in our test.
